Shameless self promotion to my own idea for how moderation should work. <----- [Link]

In short, I think moderation should be a tiered hierarchy which are voted in by users in some levels to oversee subverse moderation. This allows subverses to be completely autonomous but still be held responsible to the general userbase's best interests. Basically, subverse moderators would be checked by a governing body of moderators which are voted in by the users. The governing body is to follow rules set in place (the system). The system is overseen by a council which is also voted in by the users. It will serve to function as a government within the site to patrol moderators. This way no one moderator has all the power.

I wrote this system up because my biggest gripe over that other site was that you could create a sub which could become popular and then dictate it as you see fit. THIS IS A PUBLIC SITE BASED ON FREE SPEECH. Once your sub gets popular enough, your responsibility should be to the users, not your own agenda. Basically, you no longer get to "literally be hitler" to your subscribers. You still get to keep your sub, but now you have to use your power responsibly. This system assures that this happens fairly.
